inputs: original V10-B cached SAM prompts, original V9 detector trajectories and images
change: Do not globally relabel tracks. Swap identities only for a reciprocal two-track pair supported by three consecutive SAM associations and frozen first-frame appearance of both identities.
appearance: each crop is at least 0.15 closer to proposed immutable seed than to current identity seed; proposed distance<=0.5; seeds separated>=0.25
limitations: same-uniform swaps not solved; inherited baseline errors remain; initial appearance contaminated by occlusion can mislead
holdout_policy: CAR-NYR already used to reject V10-C; any reuse for V10-E is additional diagnostic, NOT fresh independent validation.
